target.title: [codex] Extend message_sending outbound payloads
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Plugins can observe broad outbound text through `message_sending`, but payload-capable outbound paths also need a generic way to update portable presentation, delivery fields, media refs, and structured metadata in the same final delivery hook. Splitting text mutation and presentation mutation across separate hooks makes ordering harder for plugin authors and expands the public SDK surface more than necessary.

## Why This Change Was Made

This extends the existing `message_sending` hook instead of adding a second outbound decoration hook. The existing `content`, `cancel`, `cancelReason`, and `metadata` behavior remains intact. Payload-capable send paths now include an optional normalized `payload` and hidden `outboundMetadata`; handlers can return a replacement `payload`, a `content` shorthand rewrite, or both. Core applies payload replacements before channel presentation rendering and keeps lower-priority hooks aligned with the latest content, payload, and media metadata.

## User Impact

Plugin authors get one generic outbound mutation point for text, presentation/buttons, delivery fields, media refs, and cancellation. Existing text-only `message_sending` plugins continue to work. Channel renderers still own native button/select rendering, fallback text, and transport limits.

## Evidence

Final clean branch is based on current upstream `main` (`cb44f40474b`) with one commit on top: `944ae539421`.

Validation on the clean `origin/main`-based worktree:

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/plugins/wired-hooks-message.test.ts src/infra/outbound/deliver.test.ts src/auto-reply/dispatch.test.ts extensions/slack/src/outbound-delivery.test.ts extensions/telegram/src/bot/delivery.test.ts`
  - 5 Vitest shards passed
- `pnpm plugin-sdk:api:check`
- `pnpm exec oxfmt --check docs/plugins/hooks.md docs/plugins/message-presentation.md extensions/slack/src/outbound-delivery.test.ts src/auto-reply/dispatch.ts src/auto-reply/dispatch.test.ts src/auto-reply/reply-payload.ts src/infra/outbound/deliver.ts src/infra/outbound/payloads.ts src/infra/outbound/deliver.test.ts src/plugin-sdk/core.ts src/plugins/hook-message.types.ts src/plugins/hook-types.ts src/plugins/hooks.ts src/plugins/wired-hooks-message.test.ts`
- `git diff --check HEAD~1..HEAD`
- `.agents/skills/autoreview/scripts/autoreview --mode local`
  - clean: no accepted/actionable findings

Docs: https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/hooks and https://docs.openclaw.ai/plugins/message-presentation
